lines.speaker: narrator
lines.subtitle: Three summers on, the reivers built a|fort in the fens. Vessa was sent to knock.
lines.text: Three summers on, the reivers built a fort in the fens. Vessa was sent to knock.

lines.speaker: ashby
lines.subtitle: Sergeant Ashby, my lady. Vey says I'm to|keep you alive. He says it's a full-time job.
lines.text: Sergeant Ashby, my lady. Vey says I'm to keep you alive. He says it's a full-time job.

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.subtitle: Vey worries. I've been practising.|Give me a wall and I'll burn a door through it.
lines.text: Vey worries. I've been practising. Give me a wall and I'll burn a door through it.

lines.speaker: ashby
lines.subtitle: Yes, my lady. With the army, my lady.|The army's the bit that walks behind you.
lines.text: Yes, my lady. With the army, my lady. The army's the bit that walks behind you.

lines.speaker: ashby
lines.subtitle: Reeds, my lady. Lovely place to hide|a knife. Let the lads go in first.
lines.text: Reeds, my lady. Lovely place to hide a knife. Let the lads go in first.

lines.speaker: gannet
lines.subtitle: Little match! Three years,|and you still run in alone!
lines.text: Little match! Three years, and you still run in alone!

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.subtitle: Okay. OKAY. Bad idea. Very bad idea!
lines.text: Okay. OKAY. Bad idea. Very bad idea!

lines.speaker: ashby
lines.subtitle: There! In the reeds!|That's what waiting buys you, my lady.
lines.text: There! In the reeds! That's what waiting buys you, my lady.

lines.speaker: gannet
lines.subtitle: Burn my tents, would you? I'll have|your diggers and their shovels too.
lines.text: Burn my tents, would you? I'll have your diggers and their shovels too.

lines.speaker: ashby
lines.subtitle: Hurlers! Now we're talking. They throw|farther than those towers can shoot.
lines.text: Hurlers! Now we're talking. They throw farther than those towers can shoot.

lines.speaker: gannet
lines.subtitle: Come on, match! Come and knock!|I'm right here! Just you!
lines.text: Come on, match! Come and knock! I'm right here! Just you!

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.subtitle: One tower down! Ashby, did you see?|Write it down somewhere!
lines.text: One tower down! Ashby, did you see? Write it down somewhere!

lines.speaker: gannet
lines.subtitle: Out, boys! Knock the fire-throwers flat!
lines.text: Out, boys! Knock the fire-throwers flat!

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.subtitle: See? A door! I said there'd be a door!
lines.text: See? A door! I said there'd be a door!

lines.speaker: ashby
lines.subtitle: There already was a door,|my lady. It had a latch.
lines.text: There already was a door, my lady. It had a latch.

lines.speaker: ashby
lines.subtitle: You're glowing, my lady.|More than usual, I mean.
lines.text: You're glowing, my lady. More than usual, I mean.

lines.speaker: gannet
lines.subtitle: My nest! My lovely nest!|The horn, boys! Blow the horn!
lines.text: My nest! My lovely nest! The horn, boys! Blow the horn!

lines.speaker: gannet
lines.subtitle: Keep the fort! Keep the fens!|I'm keeping my neck!
lines.text: Keep the fort! Keep the fens! I'm keeping my neck!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.subtitle: Rookhold burned until morning. So,|by accident, did the grain it had stolen.
lines.text: Rookhold burned until morning. So, by accident, did the grain it had stolen.

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.subtitle: Ashby. That was the grain. That was|the grain we came here to take back.
lines.text: Ashby. That was the grain. That was the grain we came here to take back.

lines.speaker: ashby
lines.subtitle: It was, my lady.|It's toast now. Very good toast.
lines.text: It was, my lady. It's toast now. Very good toast.

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.subtitle: The Master's going to say it.|I know he is. "Fire that will not wait..."
lines.text: The Master's going to say it. I know he is. "Fire that will not wait..."

lines.speaker: ashby
lines.subtitle: "...burns its own house." Yes,|my lady. We've all heard him say it.
lines.text: "...burns its own house." Yes, my lady. We've all heard him say it.

lines.speaker: ashby
lines.subtitle: Just a scratch! Carry on,|my lady, I'll catch you up!
lines.text: Just a scratch! Carry on, my lady, I'll catch you up!

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.subtitle: I should have... waited...
lines.text: I should have... waited...
